For security vulnerabilities, use the private email route in SECURITY.md.

## Environment

Extension version, VS Code version, operating system, and local/remote workspace.

## Reproduction

Steps and minimal synthetic Markdown. Remove secrets and private file paths.

## Behavior

Expected behavior and actual behavior. Include sanitized screenshots/logs if useful.

## Validation and impact

Checks attempted, affected workflows, frequency, and available workaround.
